name: Grok Build (Bill)
tagline: Gives the Grok Build CLI its own machine to work on
description: This one hands the actual xAI command-line coding agent a computer of its own, so you can point it at an app you want built, a code change you need made, or a long research question, without installing any tooling locally. It works at full effort on that hosted box and reports back, keeping heavy runs off your laptop.
author: Bill
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
